posts.name: Virat Kohli
posts.caption: First Indian batter to 14,000 T20 runs! Scores 9th IPL hundred this season as RCB secure playoff spot. Handshake snub of Travis Head after RCB vs SRH goes viral across cricket world.

posts.name: Narendra Modi
posts.caption: PM Modi chairs high-level meeting with Shah, Jaishankar, and Doval on US-Iran-Israel conflict. Big Tech CEOs commit $50 billion for India's AI and digital infrastructure. Quad Foreign Ministers meet May 26.

posts.name: Jensen Huang
posts.caption: Nvidia Q1 revenue hits $82 BILLION — 10x from three years ago. Demand 'gone parabolic.' Vera CPU opens $200B market. Upped quarterly dividend and added $80B to stock buyback. Vera Rubin coming Q3.

posts.name: Donald Trump
posts.caption: Postponed signing AI executive order — 'didn't like it.' Top tech CEOs including Musk, Pichai, Zuckerberg, Altman uninvited last minute. Defends $1.8B anti-weaponization fund amid GOP backlash.

posts.name: Elon Musk
posts.caption: World's first trillionaire! SpaceX Starship 12th test flight launches from Starbase, Texas. IPO projected at $2.2 trillion valuation. SpaceX exploring Tesla merger and xAI partnership.

posts.name: Mukesh Ambani
posts.caption: Reliance expands into power and telecom after family noncompete scrapped. Met Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at AI Summit. Big Tech pours $50B into India for AI and cloud infrastructure.

posts.name: D Gukesh
posts.caption: World Chess Champion faces sharp criticism from Nepomniachtchi: 'Nearly every top Grandmaster would have a good chance in a match against him.' Post-Candidates form under the microscope.

posts.name: Travis Head
posts.caption: Instagram story after Virat Kohli handshake controversy goes viral! The SRH vs RCB clash continues to generate debate across the cricket world as IPL playoff race heats up.

posts.name: Mark Zuckerberg
posts.caption: Meta cuts 8,000 jobs, moves 7,000+ to AI-focused roles. Plans $145B in AI data center spending. 'AI is the most consequential technology of our lifetimes.' Defends employee monitoring for AI race.

posts.name: MS Dhoni
posts.caption: Didn't play a single IPL 2026 game — calf strain and thumb injury. CSK eliminated after 89-run loss to GT. 'If he knows it's not right, he won't play.' The legend's future remains cricket's biggest question at 44.

posts.name: Ranveer Singh
posts.caption: Dhurandhar Raw & Undekha streaming on Netflix! Pralay shoot begins August 2026 with Rs 300 crore budget. Dhurandhar heading to Japan July 10 release.

posts.name: Shah Rukh Khan
posts.caption: KING locked for Christmas 2026! December 24 release confirmed. Deepika Padukone and Suhana Khan co-star in Siddharth Anand's action thriller with Rs 350 crore budget.

posts.name: Deepika Padukone
posts.caption: Co-starring with SRK in King this Christmas 2026. Siddharth Anand directs this action thriller with Rs 350 crore budget. Also in the spotlight as a new mother balancing blockbusters.

posts.name: Hardik Pandya
posts.caption: Fined 10% match fee for 'abuse of cricket equipment' — knocked bails off stumps in frustration during KKR loss. A tough IPL 2026: 172 runs, 4 wickets in 9 matches. Could be released before IPL 2027.

posts.name: Diljit Dosanjh
posts.caption: Dil-Luminati Tour continues across North America with sold-out shows! The Punjabi King keeps breaking records globally. Latest reel goes viral with 663K+ likes.

posts.name: Keir Starmer
posts.caption: UK PM co-chairs Paris meeting with Macron on Hormuz Strait access — 40+ countries attend. Announces free summer bus travel for kids across England. Arsenal PL title congratulations.

posts.name: Gautam Adani
posts.caption: Key legal overhang removed — SEC case settled, US drops charges. Overtakes Mukesh Ambani as Asia's richest man. Adani Group and Reliance collaborating in fuel retail.

posts.name: Sunny Deol
posts.caption: Lahore 1947 releasing globally August 13, 2026. Directed by Rajkumar Santoshi, produced by Aamir Khan. Reuniting after three decades for an epic historical drama!

posts.name: Ajay Banga
posts.caption: World Bank President unveils crisis toolkit — countries can access $60-100 billion. Backs 'Small AI' for farmers at ATX Singapore 2026. Leading global development from the front.

posts.name: Priyanka Chopra
posts.caption: Set to star as a lawyer in a dynamic new Hollywood film. Priyanka continues bridging Bollywood and Hollywood with powerful roles and global brand ambassadorship.

posts.name: Alia Bhatt
posts.caption: Bollywood's most bankable star continues with multiple projects in the pipeline. Growing international profile and brand power cement her as India's top actress.

posts.name: Shraddha Kapoor
posts.caption: Stree franchise dominance continues. India's social media queen remains the most-followed Indian actress on Instagram with a massive loyal fanbase.
